plan_review.notes: Adopted: pointer hit-testing converts Phaser world pixels to feet and uses actual NPC Size half-extents, separately requiring nearbyPlayer; closest qualifying NPC is selected with eid tie-break; real-input E2E will expose precise NPC and Awards screen-space points. Rejected sprite-interactive rearchitecture because it is invasive and unnecessary.

code_review.notes: Review round 1: ledger stage incompleteness remains expected until finalization; resolved the valid probe concern by binding its projected screen point to the NPC primed for interaction. Re-review found no implementation concerns.

independent_grade.notes: The change limits dialogue initiation to an explicit click on a nearby NPC footprint while preserving Talk, E, and active-dialogue advancement. It uses correct unit conversion and deterministic tie resolution, with unit and real-scene E2E coverage.
